item.text: The batch path currently collects every match, sorts it, and builds one `Command`, so the OS gets a single oversized argv. I’m going to split only the path portion into chunks while preserving the fixed command arguments and existing sort/output behavior.

The patch is in place. I’m formatting now and then I’ll run the existing exec-batch test area to catch any compile or behavior regressions.

item.text: The existing `test_exec_batch` passes after the change. I’m doing one quick diff sanity check now, mostly to make sure the final patch stayed small and formatted.

Implemented the fix in [src/exec/mod.rs](/Users/tapabratapal/Projects/provasign/research/harness/results/fd-neutral-c-run-2026-09-19/work/sharkdp__fd__pr866.r5.gpt55_prism/src/exec/mod.rs): `--exec-batch` now splits path arguments into multiple command invocations based on the platform command size limit instead of building one oversized argv.

Verification run:

```text
cargo fmt --check
cargo test test_exec_batch
```

Both passed. `cargo test` emitted an existing lifetime warning in `src/filesystem.rs`, unrelated to this change.
